disputes.reason: Judged without the question, a stress of interest rates on a bond portfolio can be a macroeconomic scenario shock; calling it not macroeconomic is arguable, so the false label is defensible either way.

Causal generalisation (where bank-to-bank sharing is established, regulator-to-bank sharing is less prevalent) was written into a rebuilt item; the bank itself called the original key dubious, and it cannot be verified as a syllabus fact.
